admission.justification: Future changes to host intake, task projection or task-status consumers must preserve this bounded authority: duplicate task truth, unsupported paused observations, reconstructed membership or conflicting status/age presentation produce incorrect task operations. The named current source assertions guard the specified facets; this is no fresh Curator execution grade.

applicability: Native task stage, started-task host activity and the contributing event timestamp computed by `task_state`, including the task's provider limit.
conditions: Document planning/inProgress/abandoned/Completed normalize to planned/started/aborted/completed; non-started stage takes precedence and has no activity/event time.

An unqualified host observation gives started/unknown, not paused; a state of in-turn or permission gives works, and an agent whose state is not ended with a running subagent count above zero also gives works; otherwise a complete host observation gives paused.

For an agent that works only through subagents the contributing start is the oldest running subagent's start, and an agent in a turn keeps its turn's start; the latest timestamp among the working contributors, or all observed contributors when paused, supplies eventAt, and display age derives from that timestamp, not a serialized elapsed-age field.

A task is limited when it is started, none of its agents works, and at least one of its agents is limited; the earliest reset among them is the task's, and once the display clock passes it the word is paused again with its age.
exclusions: Task body hydration, dependency readiness, worktree/process phase and session records are not additional task-stage authorities.
No guaranteed timestamp when the host supplied none, and no ageSeconds field in the task-entry wire model.
The group label and the header counts stay paused; the task counts as paused in every figure.
statement: Each task's document stage and bound-host activity determine its only stage/activity/age facts, with a permission prompt counting as work. An agent that works only through a running subagent counts as working from that subagent's oldest start, and a started task with none of its agents working and at least one of them limited takes the served limited word in place of paused.
